import json
p=r'C:\\Users\\hzq00\\.codex\\sessions\\2026\\08\\10\\rollout-2026-08-10T16-32-17-019feacd-184e-7472-9f11-ea364c22e595.jsonl'
from collections import Counter
types=Counter(); rtypes=Counter(); keys=set()
ts_min=None; ts_max=None; n=0
with open(p,'r',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    for line in f:
        n+=1
        try: o=json.loads(line)
        except Exception: continue
        t=o.get('type'); types[t]+=1
        ts=o.get('timestamp')
        if ts:
            if ts_min is None or ts<ts_min: ts_min=ts
            if ts> (ts_max or ''): ts_max=ts
        pld=o.get('payload')
        if isinstance(pld,dict):
            keys.add(tuple(pld.keys()))
            rtypes[pld.get('type')]+=1
print('lines',n)
print('ts range',ts_min,ts_max)
print('top-level types',dict(types))
print('payload types',dict(rtypes))
print('payload keys sample', list(keys)[:10])
'@ | python -"
